title: 第18章 练到家了第19章 道理
content_zh:
陈冲拿着单子出了包厢，看见于峰站在旁边等待。
于峰接过单子来看了看，并没有露出意外的表情。不过他一边带着陈冲去找郭经理，一边瞅了他两眼，忽然道
“你好像不觉得是逃过一劫。”
“我不还在这儿吗？”
陈冲淡淡道
“如果你说的是刚刚，我没听说二老板有老婆。张耀已经死了，想来我还能算个优质资产。”
于峰点了点头
“是这样。”
他们很快在办公室见到郭经理，一个戴眼镜的秃头中年男人。
他此时正忙着善后以及紧急安排替补拳手，忙得焦头烂额。不过看到造成这一切的陈冲，他却露出了笑容，眼睛甚至放出光芒——那感觉和财迷见到摇钱树差不多。
他双手握住陈冲的右手，慢慢摩挲，甚至让陈冲在一阵恶寒中怀疑他的取向
“陈冲，你真是个天才！你那个、那个，就是那个招式，能不能以后每次都来一次？不，每次都来也不好……我得再规划一下。
“先想个响亮的名字吧。叹为观止？爆裂连摔？天崩地裂？哎呀，取个什么名儿好呢？陈冲，这以后就作为你的绝杀技，怎样？
“今天这一场肯定会传出去了，下一次……三天？好，我好好安排，一定让雷龙爆满，盖过隔壁的风头！”
在郭经理的絮絮叨叨中，陈冲木然的抽出手来，很快离开了办公室。
感受着身后道道期待的目光，他感觉不大舒服。
听说张耀也是小有人气，他们之前对张耀的态度应该也不错吧？
但现在他的血已经化作他们对钞票的向往了。
想来不管张三还是陈四，在他们眼里只是带血的金币符号而已。
出来之后，陈冲见到一个不认识的男人，似乎正在等着自己。

男人身形高瘦，神情有些奇异，身上更是带着淡淡的危险气息。
这气息远远超过张耀，陈冲瞬间就站定脚步，提起警惕，紧紧盯着对方。男人也回看着陈冲，上下打量片刻，慢慢道
“没有你的话，本来今天我该划划水，输一场比赛，然后就可以拿着一大笔钱回家去了。”
陈冲皱起眉头，然而下一刻男人露出一丝古怪的微笑
“谢了。有事可以找我，但不一定能帮。”
他拍拍陈冲的肩膀，又跟于峰点点头，径直离去。
陈冲若有所思的看着他，于峰在旁淡淡道
“高磊，今天最后一场应该是他上的。”
“原来是他。”
陈冲点了点头，继续跟着于峰下楼。
他在这里已经没什么事了，所以于峰带着他又回到了候场室，再带上王力和刘河涛两人，一起从通道的后门出口出去，上了那辆商务车。
一路上，陈冲仍然沉默的靠在窗边，看着霓虹喧嚣渐渐变成晦涩的安静。
王力和刘河涛在旁边不时看向他。他们今天都没有上台就安稳度过了这一天，心里自然是觉得有些幸运的，对陈冲也充满了感激。但同时，作为一起训练的同伴，他们看陈冲的眼神也有阵阵奇异，甚至敬畏、踌躇。
本来陈冲就总给人些疏离感，四人之中，背景相似、人也阳光的李晓光和他关系要更近些。李晓光跟他们关系也不错，他在的话四人要更好相处，只可惜……现在两人看着陈冲，不只觉得距离更远，甚至还有浓浓的陌生感。
大家一起训练了这么久，陈冲也的确突出，可是他平时再优秀，和今晚台上的带来的震撼也完全是两个层次。实际上直到现在，他们的心里也是一片茫然，平时的他和今晚的他，这真的是一个人吗？
商务车又回了园区，驶到那栋小楼前。
content_en:
Chen Chong took the order out of the box and saw Yu Feng standing nearby waiting.
Yu Feng took the order and looked at it without showing any surprise. However, while taking Chen Chong to find Manager Guo, he glanced at him and suddenly said
"You don't seem to think you've escaped."
"Aren't I still here?"
Chen Chong said calmly
"If you are just talking about it, I haven't heard that the second boss has a wife. Zhang Yao is dead. I guess I can still be considered a high-quality asset."
Yu Feng nodded.
"That's right."
They soon met Manager Guo, a bald middle-aged man wearing glasses in the office.
He was busy dealing with the aftermath and urgently arranging substitute boxers, and was extremely busy. But when he saw Chen Chong, who had caused all this, he smiled, and his eyes even shone with light - the feeling was similar to a money fan seeing a money tree.
He held Chen Chong's right hand with both hands and rubbed it slowly, which even made Chen Chong doubt his orientation in a fit of chills.
"Chen Chong, you are such a genius! That, that, that move of yours, can you do it every time in the future? No, it's not good to do it every time... I have to plan it again.
“Think of a catchy name first. Breathtaking? Exploding and falling? Earth shattering? Oops, what’s a good name for it? Chen Chong, from now on this will be your ultimate move, okay?
"Today's event will definitely spread. Next time...three days? Okay, I'll make good arrangements and make sure the Thunder Dragon is full and overshadow the one next door!"
While Manager Guo was chattering, Chen Chong took out his hand numbly and quickly left the office.
Feeling the expectant eyes behind him, he felt uncomfortable.
I heard that Zhang Yao is also quite popular. Their attitude towards Zhang Yao must have been good before, right?
But now his blood has turned into their yearning for money.
Come to think of it, no matter Zhang San or Chen Si, in their eyes they are just bloody gold coin symbols.
After coming out, Chen Chong saw an unknown man who seemed to be waiting for him.
The man was tall and thin, with a strange expression and a faint aura of danger.
This aura far surpassed that of Zhang Yao. Chen Chong instantly stood still, alert, and stared at the opponent closely. The man also looked back at Chen Chong, looked up and down for a moment, and said slowly
"Without you, today I would have been paddling, losing a game, and then going home with a lot of money."
Chen Chong frowned, but the next moment the man showed a strange smile
"Thanks. You can come to me if you need anything, but I may not be able to help."
He patted Chen Chong on the shoulder, nodded with Yu Feng, and left.
Chen Chong looked at him thoughtfully, Yu Feng said calmly beside him
"Gao Lei, he should be in the last game today."
"It turned out to be him."
Chen Chong nodded and continued to follow Yu Feng downstairs.
He had nothing to do here, so Yu Feng took him back to the waiting room, then took Wang Li and Liu Hetao with him, and they went out from the back door of the passage and got into the commercial vehicle.
Along the way, Chen Chong still leaned against the window in silence, watching the neon noise gradually turn into obscure silence.
Wang Li and Liu Hetao looked at him from time to time. They spent the day safely without even going on stage. Naturally, they felt a little lucky in their hearts, and they were also full of gratitude to Chen Chong. But at the same time, as fellow trainees, they looked at Chen Chong with strange eyes, even awe and hesitation.
Originally, Chen Chong always gave people a sense of alienation. Among the four, Li Xiaoguang, who had a similar background and a bright personality, had a closer relationship with him. Li Xiaoguang also has a good relationship with them. It would be easier for the four of them to get along with him if he was here, but it's a pity... Now that the two of them looked at Chen Chong, not only did they feel further apart, but they even felt a strong sense of strangeness.
We have been training together for so long, and Chen Chong is indeed outstanding, but no matter how good he is usually, the shock he brings on stage tonight is completely different.Two levels. In fact, until now, their hearts are still at a loss. Are they really the same person between the person he usually is and the person he is tonight?
The commercial vehicle returned to the park and drove to the small building.
